limitations: Operator create/rename/archive audits belong to the new operator and cannot be read through the current tenant-fenced audit API. Exact three-event audit/replay proof is automated-only; staging verifies native UI and canonical operator reads.
Only fresh labelled operator, branch and unused future holiday fixtures are changed. The archived branch and its existing owned mirror are retained, never directly deleted.
The fresh session switches to the fixture and back. GET /me exposes no station ID; no station selection or other session mutation is performed.
Active equipment archive refusals, permission negatives, sold-holiday locks and uncertain readback cases are automated proof; no live equipment or payment record is changed.
Unrelated operator/branch rows, navigation labels and signed-in person details are hidden for proof privacy; the asserted native controls and fixture records remain visible.
Browser error kinds and partial attempts are retained. Passing these stated controls does not claim an error-free browser.
